selection_note: 1h high-absolute-profit pick: ema_trend_hold on ZEC (wide ATR×4, no trail). Score used for ranking table; final selection prefers positive 1h total return with trade/DD sanity. 4h NEAR ema_cross is best excess-vs-BH control.
honest_assessment: Selected `ema_trend_hold__ZEC__1h` on 1h: total_return 165.8017% vs paired B&H 194.0464%, MaxDD -31.011%, Sharpe 3.6669, n_trades 62. Sample ~0.3398y of 1h bars (not multi-year). Costs: 20bps one-way / 40bps RT (commission 15.0+slippage 5.0). Short-term crypto edges are fragile; no walk-forward/OOS yet. Data gaps: none for Tier A 1h. CAGR is annualized from ~0.34y — not a forward yearly forecast. 4h control: ema_cross_atr__NEAR__4h beat B&H (+78% vs +34%).

cost_assumptions.note: Crypto short-term: 40 bps RT (not equity 5–10). Maker/taker + slip realism.
